furniture.method: Each item read from an approved V4 furniture glyph or V4 fine-detail trace and cross-checked against the brochure crop; type mapped to the nearest upstream Floorplan 3D model.
furniture.convention: rot: degrees clockwise in plan (upstream Floorplan 3D convention); rot 0 = back/headboard/tank toward plan north (-y). size_px_object_frame = [width along front, depth front-to-back] in crop px; mm = px x 1000/px_per_m.
